metadata.description: One-step Microsoft Sentinel deployment package containing all custom Power Platform, Power Automate, Dataverse and Copilot Studio scheduled analytics rules plus the Power Platform Security Posture workbook.
metadata.author: power-platform-security-baseline

metadata.description: Name of the Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace.
Deploy the Power Platform Security Posture workbook alongside all analytics rules.
Display name of the Microsoft Sentinel workbook.

properties.displayName: Dataverse - Global, read or user-access audit settings disabled
properties.description:
Detects any modification to the Dataverse organization entity that disables global auditing (isauditenabled), user access auditing (isuseraccessauditenabled) or read auditing (isreadauditenabled).
Extends the out-of-the-box audit disabled rule to explicitly cover read-log and user-access-log weakening across production environments.
Maps to ASD ISM controls ISM-0580 and ISM-1228.
properties.query:
let audit_flags = dynamic([
    "isauditenabled",
    "isuseraccessauditenabled",
    "isreadauditenabled",
    "isenablesaslogginginpurview"
]);
DataverseActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where EntityName == "organization" and Message == "Update"
| mv-expand Field = Fields
| extend
    FieldName = tolower(tostring(Field.Name)),
    FieldValue = tolower(tostring(Field.Value))
| where FieldName in (audit_flags) and FieldValue in ("false", "0")
| extend
    AccountName = tostring(split(UserId, "@")[0]),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(split(UserId, "@")[1]),
    ISMControls = "ISM-0580, ISM-1228"
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    UserId,
    AccountName,
    UPNSuffix,
    ClientIp,
    InstanceUrl,
    DisabledSetting = FieldName,
    NewValue = FieldValue,
    ISMControls

properties.displayName: Dataverse - Bulk record deletion or audit log purge
properties.description:
Detects bulk record deletion jobs (BulkDelete), audit partition deletion (DeleteAuditData) or high-volume individual Delete operations in Dataverse outside approved maintenance accounts.
Maps to ASD ISM controls ISM-0585 and ISM-1511.
properties.query:
// Exclude scheduled archiving service principals once validated
let maintenance_accounts = dynamic([
    "svc-dataverse-archive@yourdomain.gov.au"
]);
let delete_threshold = 100;
DataverseActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where Message in ("BulkDelete", "DeleteAuditData", "Delete")
| where UserId !in~ (maintenance_accounts)
| summarize
    DeleteCount = count(),
    Entities = make_set(EntityName, 50),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by UserId, ClientIp, InstanceUrl, Message
| where Message in ("BulkDelete", "DeleteAuditData") or DeleteCount >= delete_threshold
| extend
    AccountName = tostring(split(UserId, "@")[0]),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(split(UserId, "@")[1]),
    ISMControls = "ISM-0585, ISM-1511"
| project
    FirstSeen,
    LastSeen,
    UserId,
    AccountName,
    UPNSuffix,
    ClientIp,
    InstanceUrl,
    Message,
    DeleteCount,
    Entities,
    ISMControls

properties.displayName: Copilot Studio - Agent created or modified to No authentication
properties.description:
Detects a Copilot Studio agent (Dataverse bot table) created or updated with authenticationmode set to 1 (No authentication).
Closes Microsoft's Sentinel logging gap for Copilot Studio admin/maker Purview events by monitoring Dataverse bot table auditing directly.
Verify the authenticationmode picklist integer in your environment and enforce PP-CS-002 DLP blocking as primary prevention.
Maps to ASD ISM controls ISM-0407 and ISM-1585.
properties.query:
// Prerequisite: enable Dataverse auditing on the 'bot' table in agent environments (PP-CS-009)
DataverseActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where EntityName == "bot" and Message in ("Create", "Update")
| mv-expand Field = Fields
| where tolower(tostring(Field.Name)) == "authenticationmode"
| extend AuthMode = tostring(Field.Value)
| where AuthMode in ("1", "None")
| extend
    AccountName = tostring(split(UserId, "@")[0]),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(split(UserId, "@")[1]),
    ISMControls = "ISM-0407, ISM-1585"
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    UserId,
    AccountName,
    UPNSuffix,
    ClientIp,
    InstanceUrl,
    BotId = tostring(EntityId),
    Message,
    AuthMode,
    ISMControls

properties.displayName: Dataverse - Mass export or bulk retrieval by guest user
properties.description:
Detects Dataverse ExportToExcel or high-volume RetrieveMultiple activity performed by an external guest account.
Closes a gap in the out-of-the-box per-user baseline export rule where newly invited guest accounts have no 14-day history and can export moderate volumes without tripping anomaly thresholds.
Requires Dataverse Read logs for the RetrieveMultiple branch. Maps to ASD ISM controls ISM-0263 and ISM-0585.
properties.query:
// Tune retrieve_threshold for environments with Read logs enabled
let retrieve_threshold = 500;
DataverseActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where Message in ("ExportToExcel", "ExportPdfDocument", "ExportWordDocument", "RetrieveMultiple")
| where UserId has "#EXT#"
| summarize
    Events = count(),
    Entities = make_set(EntityName, 50),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by UserId, ClientIp, InstanceUrl, Message
| where Message != "RetrieveMultiple" or Events > retrieve_threshold
| extend
    AccountName = tostring(split(UserId, "@")[0]),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(split(UserId, "@")[1]),
    ISMControls = "ISM-0263, ISM-0585"
| project
    FirstSeen,
    LastSeen,
    UserId,
    AccountName,
    UPNSuffix,
    ClientIp,
    InstanceUrl,
    Message,
    Events,
    Entities,
    ISMControls

properties.displayName: Power Automate - Flow created or edited following risky Microsoft Entra sign-in
properties.description:
Correlates Microsoft Entra ID Protection medium/high risk sign-ins with subsequent Power Automate flow creation or modification by the same user within 24 hours.
Detects compromised accounts establishing automated email forwarding or cloud data exfiltration workflows.
Requires Microsoft Entra ID P2 for risk fields. Maps to ASD ISM controls ISM-0585 and ISM-1228.
properties.query:
let risky_users = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
    | where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("medium", "high") or RiskState == "atRisk"
    | summarize
        RiskySignInTime = max(TimeGenerated),
        RiskLevels = make_set(RiskLevelDuringSignIn, 5),
        RiskyIPs = make_set(IPAddress, 10)
        by UserPrincipalName = tolower(UserPrincipalName);
PowerAutomateActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where EventOriginalType in ("CreateFlow", "EditFlow")
| extend UserPrincipalName = tolower(ActorName)
| join kind=inner risky_users on UserPrincipalName
| where TimeGenerated >= RiskySignInTime
| extend
    AccountName = tostring(split(ActorName, "@")[0]),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(split(ActorName, "@")[1]),
    ISMControls = "ISM-0585, ISM-1228"
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    ActorName,
    AccountName,
    UPNSuffix,
    SrcIpAddr,
    EventOriginalType,
    FlowConnectorNames,
    FlowDetailsUrl,
    RiskySignInTime,
    RiskLevels,
    RiskyIPs,
    ISMControls

properties.displayName: Power Automate - Flow created or edited with personal or external HTTP connectors
properties.description:
Detects Power Automate flows created or edited using consumer email, external file storage, messaging or raw HTTP connectors that can exfiltrate organisational data.
Acts as a detective backstop to tenant DLP policy PP-TEN-006.
Maps to ASD ISM controls ISM-0263 and ISM-1585.
properties.query:
// Validate exact connector display names in your tenant:
// PowerAutomateActivity | where isnotempty(FlowConnectorNames) | distinct FlowConnectorNames
let risky_connectors = dynamic([
    "Outlook.com",
    "Gmail",
    "Google Drive",
    "Dropbox",
    "Box",
    "HTTP",
    "FTP",
    "SFTP",
    "Telegram",
    "Slack"
]);
let approved_integration_envs = dynamic([
    "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000250"
]);
PowerAutomateActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where EventOriginalType in ("CreateFlow", "EditFlow")
| where FlowConnectorNames has_any (risky_connectors)
| extend EnvironmentId = tostring(split(parse_url(FlowDetailsUrl).Path, "/")[2])
| where EnvironmentId !in~ (approved_integration_envs)
| extend
    AccountName = tostring(split(ActorName, "@")[0]),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(split(ActorName, "@")[1]),
    ISMControls = "ISM-0263, ISM-1585"
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    ActorName,
    AccountName,
    UPNSuffix,
    SrcIpAddr,
    EventOriginalType,
    FlowConnectorNames,
    FlowDetailsUrl,
    EnvironmentId,
    ISMControls

properties.displayName: Power Automate - Flow shared with guest or external domain
properties.description:
Detects Power Automate flows shared with guest accounts (#EXT#) or recipients outside the organisation's approved internal domains.
External Owner grants (SharingPermission == 3) allow external users to inspect connection references and modify flow logic.
Maps to ASD ISM controls ISM-0407 and ISM-1585.
properties.query:
// Replace with your organisation's verified Microsoft Entra domains
let internal_domains = dynamic([
    "yourdomain.gov.au"
]);
PowerAutomateActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where isnotempty(RecipientUpn)
| extend RecipientDomain = tolower(tostring(split(RecipientUpn, "@")[1]))
| where RecipientUpn has "#EXT#" or RecipientDomain !in (internal_domains)
| extend
    Permission = case(
        tostring(SharingPermission) == "3", "Owner",
        tostring(SharingPermission) == "2", "Run-only",
        tostring(SharingPermission)
    ),
    AccountName = tostring(split(ActorName, "@")[0]),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(split(ActorName, "@")[1]),
    ISMControls = "ISM-0407, ISM-1585"
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    ActorName,
    AccountName,
    UPNSuffix,
    SrcIpAddr,
    EventOriginalType,
    RecipientUpn,
    Permission,
    FlowDetailsUrl,
    ISMControls

properties.displayName: Power Platform - DLP policy created, updated or removed by non-approved admin
properties.description:
Detects Power Platform Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy creation, modification or deletion performed by an account outside the approved Power Platform administrator list.
Closes a gap in the out-of-the-box rule 'Power Platform - DLP policy updated or removed', which ignores CreateDlpPolicy, suppresses edits within 10 minutes of creation, and does not enforce an approved administrator allow-list.
Maps to ASD ISM controls ISM-0263, ISM-0580 and ISM-1585.
properties.query:
// Replace with your PIM-eligible Power Platform administrator UPNs or a Sentinel watchlist
let approved_admins = dynamic([
    "pp-admin1@yourdomain.gov.au",
    "pp-admin2@yourdomain.gov.au"
]);
PowerPlatformAdminActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where EventOriginalType == "GovernanceApiPolicyOperation"
| mv-expand PropertyCollection
| extend
    PropName = tostring(PropertyCollection.Name),
    PropValue = tostring(PropertyCollection.Value)
| summarize Props = make_bag(bag_pack(PropName, PropValue))
    by TimeGenerated, EventOriginalUid, ActorName
| extend
    Operation = tostring(Props["powerplatform.analytics.resource.tenant.governance.api_policy.operation_name"]),
    PolicyName = tostring(Props["powerplatform.analytics.resource.display_name"]),
    PolicyId = tostring(Props["powerplatform.analytics.resource.id"]),
    ActorUpn = coalesce(tostring(Props["enduser.principal_name"]), ActorName),
    SrcIpAddr = tostring(Props["enduser.ip_address"])
| where Operation in ("CreateDlpPolicy", "UpdateDlpPolicy", "DeleteDlpPolicy")
| where ActorUpn !in~ (approved_admins)
| extend
    AccountName = tostring(split(ActorUpn, "@")[0]),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(split(ActorUpn, "@")[1]),
    CalculatedSeverity = iif(Operation == "DeleteDlpPolicy", "High", "Medium"),
    ISMControls = "ISM-0263, ISM-0580, ISM-1585"
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    ActorUpn,
    AccountName,
    UPNSuffix,
    SrcIpAddr,
    Operation,
    PolicyName,
    PolicyId,
    CalculatedSeverity,
    ISMControls

properties.displayName: Power Platform - Environment created or moved outside approved regions
properties.description:
Detects Power Platform environment provisioning, copy or move operations targeting a geography outside the organisation's approved data residency list (default: Australia).
No out-of-the-box Business Applications rule monitors environment geography or lifecycle operations.
Note: Validate exact raw EventOriginalType lifecycle strings in your tenant via a 30-day summary query before tuning.
Maps to ASD ISM controls ISM-1585 and ISM-0407.
properties.query:
// Adjust approved_regions to match organisational data sovereignty requirements
let approved_regions = dynamic(["australia", "australiaeast", "australiasoutheast"]);
let excluded_ops = dynamic([
    "EnvironmentPropertyChange",
    "EnvironmentAddedToEnvironmentGroup",
    "EnvironmentRemovedFromEnvironmentGroup"
]);
PowerPlatformAdminActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where EventOriginalType has "Environment"
| where EventOriginalType !in (excluded_ops)
| mv-expand PropertyCollection
| extend
    PropName = tostring(PropertyCollection.Name),
    PropValue = tostring(PropertyCollection.Value)
| summarize Props = make_bag(bag_pack(PropName, PropValue))
    by TimeGenerated, EventOriginalUid, EventOriginalType, ActorName
| extend
    EnvironmentId = tostring(Props["powerplatform.analytics.resource.environment.id"]),
    EnvironmentUrl = tostring(Props["powerplatform.analytics.resource.environment.url"]),
    Location = tolower(coalesce(
        tostring(Props["powerplatform.analytics.resource.environment.location"]),
        tostring(Props["location"]),
        "unknown"
    )),
    SrcIpAddr = tostring(Props["enduser.ip_address"]),
    AccountName = tostring(split(ActorName, "@")[0]),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(split(ActorName, "@")[1]),
    ISMControls = "ISM-1585, ISM-0407"
| where Location !in (approved_regions)
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    ActorName,
    AccountName,
    UPNSuffix,
    SrcIpAddr,
    EventOriginalType,
    EnvironmentId,
    EnvironmentUrl,
    Location,
    ISMControls

properties.displayName: Power Platform - Admin self-elevation or Dataverse System Administrator granted
properties.description:
Detects a tenant administrator applying the System Administrator role to themselves inside an environment (ApplyAdminRole) or a Dataverse System Administrator role being associated with a user.
Complements the out-of-the-box rule 'Power Platform - Account added to privileged Microsoft Entra roles', which covers Entra directory roles only.
Maps to ASD ISM controls ISM-0445, ISM-1175 and ISM-1228.
properties.query:
// Populate with per-environment System Administrator role GUIDs from a Sentinel watchlist
let sysadmin_role_ids = dynamic([
    "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000101"
]);
union isfuzzy=true
(
    PowerPlatformAdminActivity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
    | where EventOriginalType == "ApplyAdminRole"
    | extend Properties = tostring(PropertyCollection)
    | extend
        Environment = extract(@'"powerplatform.analytics.resource.environment.id","Value":"([^"]+)"', 1, Properties),
        SrcIpAddr = extract(@'"enduser.ip_address","Value":"([^"]+)"', 1, Properties)
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        Actor = ActorName,
        SrcIpAddr,
        Action = "Tenant admin self-elevated via ApplyAdminRole",
        Environment,
        Target = ActorName
),
(
    DataverseActivity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
    | where Message == "Associate" and EntityName == "systemuser"
    | mv-expand Field = Fields
    | where tostring(Field.Name) == "role" and tostring(Field.Value) in~ (sysadmin_role_ids)
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        Actor = UserId,
        SrcIpAddr = ClientIp,
        Action = "Dataverse System Administrator role assigned",
        Environment = InstanceUrl,
        Target = tostring(EntityId)
)
| extend
    AccountName = tostring(split(Actor, "@")[0]),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(split(Actor, "@")[1]),
    ISMControls = "ISM-0445, ISM-1175, ISM-1228"
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    Actor,
    AccountName,
    UPNSuffix,
    SrcIpAddr,
    Action,
    Environment,
    Target,
    ISMControls

properties.displayName: Power Platform - High-risk connector added to a sensitive environment
properties.description:
Detects creation of a high-risk external, file-transfer, consumer or raw HTTP connection (PutConnection) inside a designated sensitive Power Platform environment.
Enhances the Low-severity out-of-the-box rule 'Power Platform - Connector added to a sensitive environment' by explicitly flagging high-risk exfiltration connectors at High severity.
Maps to ASD ISM controls ISM-0263 and ISM-1585.
properties.query:
// Replace with your sensitive production environment GUIDs (or read from a Sentinel watchlist)
let sensitive_environments = dynamic([
    "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000201"
]);
let high_risk_connectors = dynamic([
    "shared_http",
    "shared_webcontents",
    "shared_ftp",
    "shared_sftpwithssh",
    "shared_gmail",
    "shared_outlook",
    "shared_dropbox",
    "shared_googledrive",
    "shared_box",
    "shared_slack"
]);
PowerPlatformAdminActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where EventOriginalType == "PutConnection"
| mv-expand PropertyCollection
| extend
    PropName = tostring(PropertyCollection.Name),
    PropValue = tostring(PropertyCollection.Value)
| summarize Props = make_bag(bag_pack(PropName, PropValue))
    by TimeGenerated, EventOriginalUid, ActorName
| extend
    EnvironmentId = tostring(Props["powerplatform.analytics.resource.environment.id"]),
    ConnectorId = tolower(tostring(Props["powerplatform.analytics.resource.connector.id"])),
    ConnectionId = tostring(Props["powerplatform.analytics.resource.connection.id"]),
    SrcIpAddr = tostring(Props["enduser.ip_address"])
| where EnvironmentId in~ (sensitive_environments)
| where ConnectorId has_any (high_risk_connectors)
| extend
    AccountName = tostring(split(ActorName, "@")[0]),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(split(ActorName, "@")[1]),
    ISMControls = "ISM-0263, ISM-1585"
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    ActorName,
    AccountName,
    UPNSuffix,
    SrcIpAddr,
    EnvironmentId,
    ConnectorId,
    ConnectionId,
    ISMControls

properties.displayName: Power Platform - Tenant isolation disabled or environment security group modified
properties.description:
Alerts immediately when Power Platform tenant isolation is turned off or an environment's Microsoft Entra security group binding is changed.
Closes a gap in the out-of-the-box rule 'Dataverse - Guest user exfiltration following Power Platform defense impairment', which only triggers after exfiltration alerts follow.
Maps to ASD ISM controls ISM-0263, ISM-0407 and ISM-1585.
properties.query:
PowerPlatformAdminActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where (EventOriginalType == "TenantIsolationOperation"
         and PropertyCollection has "powerplatform.analytics.resource.tenant.isolation_policy.enabled")
     or (EventOriginalType == "EnvironmentPropertyChange"
         and PropertyCollection has "SecurityGroupId")
| mv-expand PropertyCollection
| extend
    PropName = tostring(PropertyCollection.Name),
    PropValue = tostring(PropertyCollection.Value)
| summarize Props = make_bag(bag_pack(PropName, PropValue))
    by TimeGenerated, EventOriginalUid, EventOriginalType, ActorName
| extend
    IsolationEnabled = tostring(Props["powerplatform.analytics.resource.tenant.isolation_policy.enabled"]),
    EnvironmentId = tostring(Props["powerplatform.analytics.resource.environment.id"]),
    EnvironmentUrl = tostring(Props["powerplatform.analytics.resource.environment.url"]),
    SrcIpAddr = tostring(Props["enduser.ip_address"]),
    AccountName = tostring(split(ActorName, "@")[0]),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(split(ActorName, "@")[1]),
    ISMControls = "ISM-0263, ISM-0407, ISM-1585"
| where EventOriginalType == "EnvironmentPropertyChange" or IsolationEnabled =~ "False"
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    ActorName,
    AccountName,
    UPNSuffix,
    SrcIpAddr,
    EventOriginalType,
    IsolationEnabled,
    EnvironmentId,
    EnvironmentUrl,
    ISMControls
